# iaas_volume_protection_policy_attachment (Resource)

Attaches one standalone volume to a protection policy. Each volume can belong to one policy. Deleting the attachment keeps existing backups and snapshots. Other volumes on the policy are unaffected. Import as policy_uuid/volume_uuid.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iaas_volume_protection_policy_attachment" "data" {
  policy_id = iaas_volume_protection_policy.nightly.id
  volume_id = iaas_volume.data.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `policy_id` (String) Volume protection policy UUID. Changing it replaces this attachment.
- `volume_id` (String) Volume UUID. Changing it replaces this attachment.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) policy_uuid/volume_uuid

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iaas_volume_protection_policy_attachment.data <policy-uuid>/<volume-uuid>
```
